home.intro1: I'm a freelance software engineer based in Clermont-Ferrand. As {c9}, I help startups, SMEs and tech teams with their mobile and web applications, from understanding the need to shipping to production.
home.intro2: A graduate of {isima} and {esc}, I started out at {cern}, then worked at {beys}, {michelin} and for three years at {braincube}. Most recent mission: taking over {booklink}, a social reading app. In practice, I can:

can.scope: help you see clearly: scoping, technical choices, architecture, audits of existing applications;
can.build: build a mobile or web application, from design to production;
can.maintain: take over code that's been gathering dust, secure it and get it back in shape, automation and CI/CD included.

home.intro3: I'm not tied to one language: with AI, I adapt to whatever technologies the project calls for. I work on site or remotely, in French, English or Spanish. And when I have something to say, it ends up on {blog}.
home.pitch: Got a project in mind? The easiest way is a 30-minute chat.
